name: Epoxy vs Cement Grout: Where Each One Earns Its Price
title-tag: Epoxy Grout vs Cement Grout: A Tile Pro's Verdict
meta-description: Epoxy grout vs cement grout, settled: where epoxy earns its premium - showers, steam, rentals - and where sealed cement grout is the honest answer.
post-summary: November 10, 2026 · Epoxy and cement grout are different materials, not two grades of the same thing. Here is where epoxy's stain immunity and zero-maintenance surface earn the premium - showers, steam, grease zones, rentals - and where a sealed cement grout in a sensible color remains the professional answer, with the budget difference going into prep and waterproofing instead.
